title: [vercel/next.js] Fix issue #97292: Turbopack mishandles variable-assigned default exports
description:
Fix GitHub issue #97292 in vercel/next.js:
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/97292

Repo:
https://github.com/vercel/next.js

Implement a focused Turbopack fix so variable-assigned default exports in postcss.config.mjs are evaluated correctly. Keep the patch scoped to the issue and add regression coverage for the reported configuration shape.

Required deliverables:
- A real code submission, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against vercel/next.js linked to issue #97292.
- Commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Mention this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.
